Scientific Reference
VINCENT, J. L. et al. The SOFA (Sepsis-related Organ Failure Assessment) score to describe organ dysfunction/failure. Intensive Care Medicine , v. 22, n. 7, p. 707-710, 1996.

Prognosis Interpretation

Low Dysfunction (0 to 4 points)
The patient has low or absent organ dysfunction. Prognosis is generally favorable with continuous monitoring.

Moderate Dysfunction (5 to 9 points)
Increased mortality risk. Intensive management is required to reverse the causes of organ dysfunction.

Severe Dysfunction (≥ 10 points)
High intrinsic mortality risk associated with multiple organ failure. Rigorous advanced life support is required.
